method: Interleaved A/B: each round runs every unit once, each in a child process of its own on the driver's runtime, in the schedule order on even rounds and reversed on odd rounds. A child loads the case or rung from its tree, runs the check once, warms up under the policy, then meters process.resourceUsage over the sampling phase alone; cpuPerOpMs is user+system CPU of the whole process over that phase divided by the sample count. The 1-minute load average is read at the start and end of every round and at the start of every unit. A round is an outlier when max(load start, load end) exceeds 2x the block median of that value, when a unit failed, or when a unit's cpuPerOpMs lies beyond 3 x 1.4826 x MAD of that unit's block median; each outlier round is repeated once after the planned rounds, and the repeat replaces it in the summary (the original stays, marked superseded). Summary values are per-round values reduced to a median with a distribution-free order-statistic interval (95%, or the range below 6 rounds, with its coverage).
